scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir opencode-adapter build && tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir opencode-adapter typecheck && pnpm --dir console-host typecheck && pnpm --dir ui/teams-console typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --dir opencode-adapter build && pnpm --dir console-host build && pnpm --dir ui/teams-console build && pnpm build:runtime
scripts.build:runtime: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('generated/runtime-lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && appsdk guide compile && appsdk compile && pnpm smoke && appsdk verify
